about_the_game:
🕊️ The Protagonist

A haunting descent into memory, silence, and the frozen remains of a broken world.

In the frozen silence of a dead Earth, memories are the only thing that still burn.
The Protagonist is a narrative-driven psychological horror experience set 635 years after the sun died.
You play as Varon Orimir, a shattered soul chasing a mysterious radio signal through the ice-entombed ruins of a forgotten civilization — a voice that sounds like his long-lost daughter.

🎮 Gameplay & Mechanics

  • No combat — only choices, consequences, and memories.
    The game focuses on exploration, symbolic decision-making, and memory-based puzzles in a surreal and ever-changing world.

  • Radio as your lifeline
    A mysterious walkie-talkie delivers fragmented voice messages — some helpful, some deceptive. Which voices will you trust?

  • Fractured environments
    Traverse subterranean sanctuaries, abandoned shrines, and hallucinatory therapy rooms that visually shift with your mental state and past decisions.

  • An unforgettable emotional story
    Dive deep into a story about grief, guilt, and the longing for redemption, told through distorted memories, symbolic spaces, and chilling voice-overs. Every step brings you closer to a painful truth — or a comforting lie.

🧠 Story & Themes

Centuries after the sun’s collapse — an event known as Stillwake — Earth is a frozen wasteland. The remnants of humanity survive deep underground, clinging to geothermal warmth and flickering hope.

You are Varon Orimir, a former NOVA pilgrim burdened by an unspeakable past.
When a voice on the radio echoes the words of your missing daughter, you descend into a world where memories lie, reality fractures, and truth is a choice.

💡 What Makes It Unique

  • Emotionally intense, voice-driven narrative
    Most of the story unfolds through atmospheric exploration, ambient audio, and fragmented radio dialogue — blurring the line between memory and madness.

  • Worlds that reflect your mind
    The game’s environments twist and distort based on your psyche, your decisions, and your inner state.

  • Post-apocalyptic silence, not action
    No weapons. No combat. Just you, your thoughts, and a dying world that remembers everything you’ve done.

🕓 Playtime

1–2 hours of tightly focused, atmospheric storytelling.
Designed to be completed in one emotional, unforgettable session.

🔊 Sound & Music

  • Original, haunting, and emotional score
    Every note reinforces the themes of loss, isolation, and fading hope.

  • Immersive 3D sound design
    Voices whisper. Static breathes. The silence itself becomes a threat.

🧩 Core Themes

  • Memory vs. Reality

  • Guilt and Forgiveness

  • Voice and Silence

  • Loss and Hope in a dead world

content_descriptors.notes:
Psychological trauma, loss, and grief

Implied self-harm and emotional breakdown

Depictions of emotional abuse and guilt

Hallucinations, paranoia, and loss of reality

Disturbing sound design, symbolic imagery, and visual disorientation

No explicit sexual content or graphic violence, but a heavy focus on psychological tension and inner conflict
